product.name: Chimsoc High Temperature Rubber Pipe Flashing - Red SILICONE - 5-55mm Diameter - CF2HTR
product.description:
Base dimensions:- 135mm x 135mm
Suits Pipe Diameters:- 5mm to 55mm (1/4" to 2 1/8")
Suits Roof Pitches:- 0-40 degrees
Temperature Range:- -50 to +225 Degrees C, and up to 260 Degrees C intermittently.

Chimsoc Pipe Flashings, available in Red, Grey and Black High Temperature Silicone, are a top quality solution for sealing around pipes penetrating through roofs, providing a reliable and long-lasting weather resistant seal.

Designed to withstand temperatures up to 225°C continuous, and 260°C intermittently, Chimsoc Pipe Flashings are suitable for use on high temperature applications such as chimneys, exhaust vents, and flues. The red, grey and black coloured silicone material ensures a sleek and unobtrusive finish, making them an excellent choice for modern and traditional roofs alike.

Easy to install and highly flexible, Chimsoc High Temperature Pipe Flashings offer excellent resistance to UV, ozone, and weathering, making them a reliable and cost effective solution for your roofing needs.

HIGH TEMPERATURE RESISTANCE
Silicone rubber has a MUCH higher temperature resistance then EPDM rubber. Our silicone pipe flashings can be used from -50 to +225 Degrees C, and up to 260 Degrees C intermittently. It is recommended to use silicone pipe flashings for wood burning and multi fuel stove installations.

NOW IN BLACK AND GREY COLOURS
Traditionally high temperature silicone pipe flashings have been red in colour. We offer red, and uniquely also give the option of black and grey colours.

product.name: Chimsoc High Temperature Pitched Tile Pipe Flashing - Aluminium Base - Black SILICONE Cone - 75-200mm Diameter - CS-CFAL1HTB
product.description:
Suits Pipe Diameters:- 75mm to 200mm (3" to 8")
Base dimensions:- 605mm x 505mm
Suits Roof Pitches:- 20-45 degrees
Temperature Range:- -50 to +225 Degrees C, and up to 260 Degrees C intermittently.

CHIMSOC high temperature pitched tile pipe flashings are the solution for flashing pipes through tiled roofs. Manufactured using HIGH TEMPERATURE silicone rubber, with a flexible aluminium base to allow the pipe flashing base to be adjusted to suit almost any contour.

HIGH TEMPERATURE RESISTANCE
Silicone rubber has a MUCH higher temperature resistance then EPDM rubber. Our silicone pipe flashings can be used from -50 to +225 Degrees C, and up to 260 Degrees C intermittently. It is recommended to use silicone pipe flashings for wood burning and multi fuel stove installations.

Installation
1. Pull tab design to correct size using pliers, alternatively cut.
2. Apply silicone sealant to back of flashing.
3. Remove tiles around pipe and slide flashing over pipe.
4. Fasten flashing to the roof.
5. Cut tile to fit to the top of the flashing allowing the bottom of the flashing metal base to sit on top of the tiles.

product.name: Fullex Kinetica+ K4 3-Star Keyed-Alike Euro Cylinders - Chrome, 50/50 (100mm), 3 Extra (8 total)
product.description: Pair of high security TS007 3-Star Kinetica+ keyed-alike euro cylinders combining advanced anti-snap, anti-bump, anti-drill, anti-pick and anti-plug pull protection with its revolutionary anti-tilt cam and sprung anti-grip drive bar. Recognised as leading the field in euro cylinder security, Kinetica+ holds Secured by Design accreditation and provides outstanding resistance against lock-snapping attacks. Kinetica+ uses a variety of specially engineered, hardened steel anti-bump, drill, and pick pins, whilst its core is reinforced by a super-strong strengthening bar that ensures a robust and durable lock. Lock snapping is a huge concern, so Kinetica+ combines several defensive mechanisms. A sacrificial cut ensures the cylinder snaps in front of the vulnerable cam area, and at the moment of failure, an anti-grip drive bar springs forward, and is stopped by dual attack rods that fire sideways. The rotating cam moves independantly, and stops when its outer defence ring hits the barrels. Dual attack rods limit the space attacker can work in, making it impossible to push the drive bar backwards to release the cam. product.name: Bar Original The Big Pipe Port Wine Brandy Sipper Glass
product.description: The BIG Pipe Sipper Glass (250ml) The bowl of the pipe will express the aroma of your drink while you sip through the narrow pipe tube. Traditionally, port wine was served in sipping pipes, which look like large glass Smoking pipes, such as this. The stem of the pipe acts like a straw, so you sip the wine from the bottom, drinking the port that hasn’t been exposed to air. This way, most of the liquid is untouched by oxygen, reducing oxidation and preserving the wine’s original, intended flavour. Port sippers date back to the 17th century. Perfect for. .. Use with brandy, port and many other types of liqueurs and spirits. Mixer drinks. Holding 250ml there is enough capacity for a stylish-looking mixer drink! Creating Smoking cocktails. If you know how or want to start making smoking cocktails, this glass being pipe shaped is the perfect-looking glass! Drink Port The traditional way. Sip from the spout and appreciate the rich, full-bodied flavour of the unoxidised drink as it feeds from the bottom of the glass. Specifications Glass Dimensions: 17 x 9 x 6. 5cm. Glass Capacity: 250ml. Material: Borosilicate glass. Cleaning: Handwash only. Features Enhances the flavour of your drink. Made from tough borosilicate glass. How to Make a Port and Tonic Cocktail Fill the glass with a Port and Tonic (Porto Tonico) cocktail. A light, slightly sweet and refreshing cocktail that’s easy to make. Method Add 2 ice cubes to the glass. Pour one part Port with 2 parts Tonic Water. Wash and slice the orange. Add an orange slice to the glass. Top with a sprig of mint. Why Choose a 3 Column Radiator?

A 3 column radiator features three rows of vertical pipes inside each section, rather than one or two rows. This specific construction significantly increases the surface area of the radiator. When there is more metal in contact with the air, a higher heat output is achieved. This makes it a great choice for boosting temperatures in cold, larger rooms.

The Aquarius Foundry 4 Column Horizontal Radiator delivers a modern interpretation of the classic multi-column radiator design. A 4 column radiator is built with four distinct rows of vertical tubing within every section. This configuration provides a deeper profile that packs a larger surface area into a compact footprint.

product.name: Hoses UK 28mm Black PVC Corrugated Flexible Water Butt Hose 25m Reinforced Downpipe Connector Rainwater Harvesting Pump Pond
product.description: The Hoses UK Black PVC Corrugated Water Butt & Pond Hose is a high-quality, flexible hose designed for connecting water butts, downpipes, and ponds. Its solid black wall helps prevent algae growth in outdoor systems, making it an ideal choice for rainwater harvesting and pond circulation applications. Made from smooth PVC inner layer with UV-resistant corrugated PVC outer wall, this hose features high-tensile plastic rib reinforcement to provide durability and crush resistance while maintaining flexibility. The clear design allows easy monitoring of water or fluid movement, making it suitable for a wide range of light to medium-duty environments. Operating within the temperature range of -10 degrees C to +65 degrees C (peak +70 degrees C), this hose is compliant with BS EN ISO 3994-2001 standards and offers reliable performance across repeated use. The hose can be cut to length, fitted with hose clips (sold separately), and features a working pressure range of 3 to 5 bar with a burst factor of three times the rating. Its transparent construction allows operators to monitor flow and detect blockages or contamination quickly, making it particularly useful in pond systems, aquatics, and industrial water circulation. Typical applications include pond and aquarium circulation, garden water features, drainage systems, irrigation setups, light industrial fluid handling tasks, workshop water transfer, and light chemical solutions where visibility and flexible installation are essential.

product.name: Pegdev Detectable Mesh (Gas Pipe) Durable Underground Service Marker 200mm x 26m
product.description: Pegdev Detectable Gas Pipe Mesh is designed to provide a clear and highly visible warning for buried underground gas pipes during excavation work. Manufactured from high-strength, rot-resistant yellow HDPE, the mesh features an integrated detectable wire and repeated printed “CAUTION - BURIED GAS PIPE” warning text. The highly visible yellow colour helps identify buried gas pipes when the mesh is exposed during excavation. Designed to be clearly visible when pulled up in an excavator bucket, the mesh provides an obvious warning to groundworkers and excavation teams. The integrated detectable wire allows the mesh to be located from the surface, providing an additional method of identifying underground gas pipe routes before or during groundworks. This durable warning mesh is suitable for contractors, builders, utility companies, landscapers and groundworkers working on construction and excavation projects. The mesh is rot resistant and manufactured from durable HDPE to withstand demanding underground conditions, providing a long-lasting solution for underground service identification. The repeated warning message provides clear visual identification when the mesh is uncovered. Conforms to BS12613:2023 and provides a practical solution for clearly marking buried gas pipe services during construction, excavation and groundworks. product.description: Premium quality anti-snap thumbturn euro cylinder, offering maximum protection against lock snapping, bumping, and other common attack methods. Thumbturn cylinders are great for regular use doors, as they provide convenient internal locking and unlocking, without the need to have keys at hand. These cylinders feature a sacrificial breakpoint, which releases the external side of the cylinder during a snap attack, leaving the cam protected, and engaging an interlocking mechanism that prevents further damage to the lock. product.name: Westco 22mm Single Check Valve WRAS - Stops Backflow, Easy Compression Fit, No Soldering, DZR Brass Non-Return Valve
product.description: Worried about dirty or used water flowing back into your clean supply? This Westco 22mm single check valve solves that problem. It is a brass non-return valve that lets water flow in one direction only and blocks backflow, helping to keep your drinking water protected from contamination. It has 22mm compression connections on both ends (22mm C x C), so it fits straight onto 22mm copper pipe with just a spanner. There is no soldering, no blowtorch and no need to call a plumber, which makes it a sensible job for a weekend DIYer as well as a trade fitter. Simply cut the pipe, slide on the compression nuts and olives, and tighten up for a secure, watertight joint. The body is made from DZR (dezincification resistant) brass, a solid, hard-wearing material that resists corrosion and lasts well in domestic plumbing systems. It is WRAS approved, giving you confidence that it is suitable for use with UK potable water systems and for meeting UK Water Regulations. Check valves are required on many UK plumbing connections to prevent contamination of the drinking water supply, so this is a simple but important fitting for any home. Suitable for domestic water systems, rental properties and general plumbing repairs or upgrades where a 22mm single check valve is needed. Supplied as a single fitting. A reliable, standard-size choice for homeowners, landlords and tradespeople alike.

Manufactured from durable ABS plastic, this fitting offers reliable strength while remaining lightweight and easy to install. This component is a precision 3D printed ABS part, produced for accurate sizing and dependable performance. The barbed ends provide a secure push-fit connection inside flexible hose, helping to minimise leaks and maintain consistent flow. The reducer design enables connection between two different hose sizes without the need for additional adapters.

The 45-degree angle supports improved hose routing compared to straight connectors, helping reduce kinking and stress on pipework. Suitable for use with PVC hose, rubber hose, and other flexible pipe systems, this joiner performs reliably in outdoor and wet environments. Resistant to water and general wear, it provides dependable performance for both DIY users and professional installers. Whether adapting hose sizes or changing direction within a system, this reducer barbed joiner offers a practical and efficient solution.

Each 500mm grating is secured by a bolt and locking bar

product.name: 8mm 45 Degree Plastic Hose Connector Black Barbed Hose Connector for Garden Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes
product.description: This 45 Degree Plastic Hose Connector is a practical solution for creating smooth, angled connections between hoses. Manufactured from tough, lightweight ABS plastic, it offers excellent durability and resistance to weathering, corrosion, and everyday wear. The 45-degree design helps reduce hose stress while maintaining steady water flow, making it particularly useful in spaces where a gentle directional change is required. With its barbed ends, the connector ensures a firm grip on the hose, preventing leaks and slippage even when used under pressure. Perfect for use with garden hoses, pond hoses, aquarium setups, or general water systems, this connector supports efficient water management in both domestic and professional settings. Quick and easy to install, simply push the hose ends over the barbs to achieve a secure, watertight seal. Whether used in irrigation, pond filtration, or household water projects, it helps maintain neat and organised hose routing while protecting hoses from kinking. Combining reliability, strength, and ease of use, this connector is an essential accessory for gardeners, pond enthusiasts, and DIY users who need a cost-effective and long-lasting way to manage hose connections effectively.

product.name: DIYUK W2 Stainless Steel Worm Drive Hose Clips, Adjustable Pipe Clamps, 190-210mm, Pack of 10
product.description:
Need a secure, adjustable grip on a hose, pipe or duct? These W2 stainless steel worm drive hose clips clamp flexible hose, pipe and ducting onto spigots and barbed or ridged fittings: HVAC and ducting connections, domestic and agricultural plumbing, including washing machine drain hoses, and workshop and light industrial hose and pipe fastening. They work as metal hose clamps, hose pipe clamps, stainless steel pipe clamps and duct clamps. This pack contains 10 hose clips in the 190-210mm size.

The band and housing are stainless steel for strong resistance to rust and general weathering, with a zinc-plated steel hex-head screw with a combined slot and cross drive, so it takes a flat-blade or cross-head screwdriver.

The worm drive engages an embossed band 9mm wide and 0.7mm thick for fine, even tightening across the full clamping range, and the slim band keeps the clip low-profile once fitted. The clamping range is embossed on every band, so each size is easy to identify. A recommended tightening torque of 4.0 Nm (approx. 35 lbf in) guides correct fitting.

Specification:
Clamping range: 190-210mm (7.48-8.27in)
Band and housing: stainless steel
Screw: zinc-plated steel, hex head with a combined slot and cross drive
Grade: W2
Band width: 9mm
Band thickness: 0.7mm
Recommended tightening torque: 4.0 Nm
Mechanism: worm drive
Pack size: 10

Choosing a size: each size is named by its closed and fully open diameter, so this 190-210mm clip closes down to 190mm and opens as wide as 210mm. Measure the outer diameter of the hose once it is fitted over its connector, then choose the size whose range spans that diameter.

Eighteen sizes from 8-12mm to 190-210mm, in packs of 1, 2, 5 and 10.

product.name: Westco 15mm Compression Brass BS Gate Valve - Easy Fit Lockshield Isolating Valve for Heating, No Soldering Needed
product.description: Need to shut off or balance the water flow to a radiator or pipe run without calling a plumber? This Westco 15mm compression brass BS gate valve is a straightforward way to do it. It has 15mm compression connections at both ends, so it fits onto standard 15mm copper pipe with a spanner and no soldering, blowtorch or special tools. It is a lockshield gate valve, which means the cap helps prevent accidental adjustment between services once the system has been set up. That makes it a sensible choice for isolating and balancing water flow in central heating and domestic plumbing systems, where gate valves are a standard fitting in UK installations. The solid brass body is built for strength and long-term reliability, and the gate valve design gives positive shut-off when you need to isolate part of the system for repairs, replacing a radiator or draining down a section of pipework. It is suitable for hot and cold water systems, so it works equally well on heating flow and return pipework and on general domestic plumbing. Whether you are a weekend DIYer swapping an old valve, a landlord keeping a rental property maintained, or a first-time buyer tackling a simple plumbing job, the 15mm compression size is the one to look for on typical 15mm copper pipework. Check your pipe size before you buy: this valve is for 15mm pipe only.
